## Design

### 2026-10-04 — Project planning & component research.

**1h**

Project planning & component research.

I started planning out Reflex to figure out what the project needs. I decided that the most basic system will use a push button, an LED, and a microcontroller. Below is the basic system layout.

![Screenshot 2026-10-04 094820](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cavLLmYzVkZWo0utyyD4hUaCvcnGNniC/aeb3c175a1deb2b0ef86a52b1693f1377bfe9348708d505fbc999faa9c180a3b.png)

The LED will turn on after a random delay. After it turns on, it will start counting the time taken until the button is pressed.

After I looked a little deeper into what hardware I wanted, I made a ReadME.

![Screenshot 2026-10-04 100347](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cavLLmYzVkZWo0utyyD4hUaCvcnGNniC/de96baea9180bdc280ffcc48f44f04964a484f0a6cd937e29185d14532c1be1b.png)

### 2026-10-04 — Adding parts to the Bill of Materials

**0.5h**

Adding parts to the Bill of Materials

While I was looking for the specific listings of parts, I realized that inflation hit pretty hard and I can't get everything under $30. I reduced my costs as much as possible by looking for a kit and removing the OLED display from the design.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/cavLLmYzVkZWo0utyyD4hUaCvcnGNniC/2f51d5b76fb1ee65c0d50d2c75097f2907faf41d5033ffd0d4f44c75ae57d536.png)
